summary.lv: Clarity Labs SIA meklē Automation QA konsultantu/-i ar pieredzi Tricentis Tosca un Playwright rīkos, kurš/-a veiks automatizētu testu izstrādi un uzturēšanu, funkcionālo un API testēšanu CI/CD vidē.
summary.en: Clarity Labs SIA is hiring an Automation QA Consultant with hands-on Tricentis Tosca and Playwright experience to design, develop, and maintain automated test suites covering functional, API, and regression testing within CI/CD pipelines.
